preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setAllFeePercent() with values that sum to more than 25% (e.g., taxFee=10, liquidityFee=10, burnFee=10, walletFee=10, buybackFee=10 for a total of 50%). This bypasses the intended reasonable limit of 25% total fees mentioned in the vulnerability description. The function only checks individual fee caps (maxTaxFee=10, maxLiqFee=10, etc.) but doesn't enforce a total fee cap.
